title: Two minutes.
caption: Two minutes. No account, nothing saved. Mira shows the Calm kit inside Waypoint.
linkedin_text: A small addition to Waypoint this week: the Calm kit. Breathe, ground yourself, wind down. Two minutes each, no account, nothing saved. Mira shows it on the real app. It is a feature, not a promise.

scenes.clip: Mira, a young woman with long dark hair in a lilac hoodie, stands in a quiet kitchen late at night, one lamp on, turns to the camera with a gentle smile, a kettle steaming.
scenes.vo: Hi, I'm Mira. This is Priya's story. Her day runs on a timetable. Her evenings do not.
scenes.sub: Hi, I'm Mira. This is Priya's story. Her day runs on a timetable. Her evenings do not.
scenes.title: Two minutes.

scenes.clip: A young woman in office clothes on a late evening commuter train, head against the window, city lights streaking past, tired.
scenes.vo: Some nights she just wants two minutes that belong to her.
scenes.sub: Some nights she just wants two minutes that belong to her.

scenes.clip: The same young woman sitting on the edge of her bed at night, phone in both hands, eyes closed, breathing slowly, soft lamp light.
scenes.vo: Waypoint has a Calm kit now. Breathe. Ground yourself. Wind down. Two minutes each, no account, nothing saved.
scenes.sub: Waypoint has a Calm kit now. Breathe. Ground yourself. Wind down. Two minutes each, no account, nothing saved.

scenes.clip: A phone on a pillow showing a single glowing question, a young woman's hand reaching for it, night, warm light.
scenes.vo: Then the Daily Path, one question for everyone. She answers it slower tonight.
scenes.sub: Then the Daily Path, one question for everyone. She answers it slower tonight.

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a black-and-white floral shirt and khaki shorts, sits on a balcony at night reading his phone and nodding slowly, as if someone else had the same evening, city glow behind.
scenes.vo: And on the Wall, another person had the same kind of evening.
scenes.sub: And on the Wall, another person had the same kind of evening.

scenes.vo: Waypoint. Two minutes that are yours. Free on Google Play.
